response.rationale: A and B are related but not the same concept. A is "Booking Status", the lifecycle state of a booking ("pending", "paid"), which BookingRepository checks with `b.status === "pending" || b.status === "paid"`. B is "Booking", the reservation itself, whose status ReportService reads with `b.status === "paid"`. Both snippets read the same `status` field, but that only shows the status is an attribute of a booking. An attribute and the thing that owns it are different concepts.
